_note: Trainer settings (camelCase = buildArgs args, UPPER_CASE = training_config.json keys, as in node/sweep.mjs --set) tuned on MNIST 28x28 test digits: always growing from 1 site, λ 0 so runs end at their budget, 1000 iterations, L1 loss, by mean final PSNR over 20 digits (2 per class) at budgets of 8 and 32 sites. A ~10 min coordinate search from presets/kodak.json over growth schedule, growth LR decay, LR multiplier / position LR and LR schedule; runs vary by about ±0.25 dB. On 20 held-out digits: 20.97 dB vs 16.36 dB for the Kodak settings (both L1). λ 400 (the Kodak value) stops growth at ~2.5 sites on 28x28, since a site costs 128 bits = 0.16 bpp; at a 32-site cap λ 25 ends at ~29 sites for -1 dB. A second ~10 min search over color space and the six base LRs (×0.5 / ×2, two passes) moved colorSpace rgb -> logchroma (+1.2 dB on the tuning digits) and lrColorBase 0.01 -> 0.005; held out: 21.49 vs 21.07 dB. lrPosBase 0.2 scored +0.06 dB (under the 0.15 dB bar), the rest within noise. Not tuned: τ / radius init, candidate settings. Hand-set afterwards (not from a sweep): growEvery 5 -> 50, growLrDecay 1 -> 0.5, logFreq (refresh every) 5. Then a 48-setting grid over lrMult {1,2,4} × growLrDecay {1,0.7,0.5,0.3} × growEvery {10,25,50,100} (same tuning digits and budgets) picked lrMult 4, growLrDecay 0.5, growEvery 10: 20.27 dB vs 18.81 dB for the hand-set values. growEvery mattered most (100 → 10: +1.9 dB averaged over the rest); lrMult 2 and 4 were within noise of each other, 1 was worse; growLrDecay 0.3 was worse, 0.5–1 within noise. The LR warmup (200 of the 1000 iterations) was removed afterwards: within ±0.2 dB on MNIST and Kodak. Site count mapped afterwards to the start/end schedule: 1 → 32, exponential, reached at 10% of the run (countEnd 0.1). On 40 held-out digits 22.13 dB vs 20.92 at 30%; slower ramps take many small growth steps, and growLrDecay 0.5 compounds per step. A sawtooth (4 teeth, +50%, 3:1) reached at 10% scored 23.26 dB, but with a step every 10 its teeth are too short to go down, so that is only a coarser growth sequence (7 steps instead of ~20); reached at 30%, where it does merge, sawtooth scored 22.25 dB vs 20.92 for exponential. Then a sweep of the count schedule (two rounds, 175 settings: exponential reach-end-by × step-every, sawtooth teeth × amplitude × grow:merge × reach-end-by × step-every; same tuning digits and budgets) picked sawtooth, 2 teeth, amplitude 2, grow:merge 1, reached at 10%, a step every 10: 21.17 dB vs 19.88 for the best exponential. On 40 held-out digits: 21.88 dB vs 19.85 for the exponential preset and 21.06 for the best exponential (which reached at 5% falls short of 32 sites). Then a learned-depth layer (layer learn: the peak of the smoothed color histogram, black here, becomes a flat site behind every other; its depth starts at the log-odds of the peak's mass and is learned): on 40 held-out digits × 5 repeats, +0.78 ± 0.28 dB at 8 sites and +3.06 ± 0.41 at 32 vs no layer (the thresholded layer auto: +0.11 / +1.51; adding info commit: +0.39 / +3.04). Later removed from the trainer (ablations within noise or negative): growth LR decay, Hilbert-order candidate probes, τ-gradient diffusion, keep-best, growth blur, insertion growth, MDL stop and pruning. Then fixed at 8 sites (the layer included) so dataset batches train as one atlas (trainer/batch.js); on 256 test digits batched and single runs both averaged about 20.6 dB. Then auto-tuned in train.html (the tune buttons: median final PSNR over a dataset batch, ×/÷ per round on the same images): loss l1 -> l2, lrMult 4 -> 6.75, lrPosBase 0.1 -> 0.15, lrTauBase 0.005 -> 0.01688, lrColorBase 0.005 -> 0.0075, lrAnisoBase 0.025 -> 0.01875, persist weight 0 -> 0.05625 (cap 9); then set to 10 fixed sites and 100 iterations (the constant schedule). Then the six LR bases tuned headless (node/tune.mjs, step decaying ×2 → ×1.1, median PSNR over test digits 0–1023; node/e1.mjs): lrPosBase 0.15 -> 0.09098, lrTauBase 0.01688 -> 0.0161, lrColorBase 0.0075 -> 0.04087, lrDirBase 0.0025 -> 0.01, lrAnisoBase 0.01875 -> 0.05309 (radius kept). On held-out digits 1024–3071: 17.58 dB vs 16.28 median. Then the color params got one shared Adam second moment (colorMoment shared, the EMA of |g_color|²; before, logchroma / ycocg / klt sites drifted off grey, R−G 1st–99th percentile −0.83…+0.09 for logchroma, outliers to 50) and every training color space was retuned and compared (node/colorspaces.mjs: six LR bases tuned per space on digits 0–1023, median PSNR on held-out digits 1024–3071 × 3 repeats, codec bits/site pooled over those digits). Held out, shared: rgb 18.16 dB / 36.04 bits, logchroma 18.03 / 36.32, ycocg 18.26 / 37.25, klt 18.31 / 36.02; per-param moments, same day: rgb 18.18 / 35.67, logchroma 17.78 / 37.70, ycocg 18.01 / 35.88, klt 18.13 / 37.14 (repeats agree within ~0.05 dB; retuning the same setting moves the result by up to ~0.25 dB). Picked klt with its tuned bases, best on PSNR and on bits: colorSpace logchroma -> klt, lrPosBase 0.09098 -> 0.1028, lrTauBase 0.0161 -> 0.00805, lrRadiusBase 0.01 -> 0.01414, lrColorBase 0.04087 -> 0.0289, lrDirBase 0.01 -> 0.04911, lrAnisoBase 0.05309 -> 0.06074: 18.31 dB vs 17.78 for the previous logchroma preset (per-param moments).
